title: Counter Card: Inspections Logged in the Year and the Allowance Granted
content:
Where fewer inspections have been logged on a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans than its interval calls for, the allowance granted for the coverage year is taken at a share rather than in full.

The inspections a year calls for are the whole number of times the coverage's inspection interval fits into 12 months. Where fewer inspection entries stand on the plan in the 12 months to the handling date than the coverage's inspection interval calls for and the most recent of them falls within that interval, the grant is taken at 90 percent. Where fewer stand in that period than the interval calls for and the most recent of them falls outside that interval, the grant is taken at 60 percent. In any other case the grant is taken whole and unreduced.

## Where the inspection record falls

| Inspection entries in the 12 months to the handling date | The most recent inspection entry | The share the grant is taken at |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than the interval calls for | falls within the coverage's inspection interval | 90 percent |
| fewer than the interval calls for | falls outside that interval | 60 percent |
| as many as the interval calls for, or more | either | the whole grant, unreduced |

## What each plan's interval calls for

| Plan | Inspection interval, whole months | Inspections a year calls for |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 12 | 1 |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 6 | 2 |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 6 | 2 |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 6 | 2 |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 6 | 2 |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 4 | 3 |

## Worked reading

On coverage inspected every 6 months, a year calls for 2 inspections. A plan carrying 1 inspection entry in the 12 months to the handling date, logged 3 whole months ago, is short of what the interval calls for and its most recent entry falls within the interval, so the grant is taken at 90 percent. The same plan whose single entry was logged 8 whole months ago has its most recent entry outside the interval, so the grant is taken at 60 percent.
